newsitem.title: ISRAEL: PLO security chief blasts Israel over closure.
newsitem.headline: PLO security chief blasts Israel over closure.

text.p: A senior Palestinian security official on Friday blasted Israel's closure of the West Bank and Gaza Strip for fear of Islamic militant attacks, saying Israel's security forces were "paranoid".
"The Israeli security establishment is living a state of paranoia over incorrect information and assessments," Jibril Rajoub, head of Palestinian Preventive Security in the West Bank, told Reuters.
"We have asked (Israeli Chief of Staff Amnon) Shahak yesterday to lift the siege because it does not reflect the reciprocity they are talking about," he said.

Israel sealed its borders with the West Bank and Gaza Strip on Wednesday, two days ahead of the October 26 anniversary of the assassination of Islamic Jihad leader Fathi Shqaqi in Malta by gunmen widely believed to be Israeli agents.
Israel said the closure followed extensive intelligence warnings that Islamic Jihad was planning suicide bombings in Israel to mark the anniversary.
The closure, the third one of its kind this year, prevents thousands of Arab labourers from reaching jobs in Israel and curtails Palestinian exports and imports.
"The closure is being used to besiege and strangle the Palestinian people. There is no justification for this ring," Rajoub said.
Islamic militants killed 59 people in four suicide bombings in February and March in Israel in revenge for the assassination of a Hamas bombmaker in Gaza a few months earlier.
The Palestinian Authority and Israel have since rounded up hundreds of suspected Hamas and Islamic Jihad activists.
